name: Helical Display Surface Geometry & Balancing
definition: A rotating double-helix reflector surface used to display 3D volumetric images via laser scanning, designed to minimize vibration and aerodynamic drag while maximizing structural stiffness.
summary: Helical Display Surface Geometry & Balancing is a mechanical design for rotating double-helix reflectors that ensures structural integrity and optical stability at high speeds through axisymmetric contours and dynamic balancing.
